map.孔口出流按托里拆利公式的修正形式计算：理想流速为 √(2gH)，乘孔口面积 A: Orifice outflow is computed from a corrected form of the Torricelli formula: the ideal velocity is √(2gH), multiplied by the orifice area A = πd²/4 to get the theoretical flow, and then by the discharge coefficient Cd to correct for contraction and viscous loss. A sharp-edged orifice takes Cd of about 0.60-0.65 and a rounded one can reach 0.98, and the discharge is proportional to the square root of the acting head.
